title: Universal-existential characterization of the second hierarchy class
statement: For every language $L$ of finite binary strings, $L\in\Pi_2^P$ if and only if there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V\in\mathsf{P}$ such that, for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the following condition: for every binary string $u$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$, there is a binary string $v$ of that same length for which $\langle\langle x,u\rangle,v\rangle\in V$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of finite binary strings
